candidate_solve.derivation: Take tabletop edge as U = 0. Dangling segment of length y0 has mass lambda*y0 with center of mass at -y0/2, so U_i = -0.5 * lambda * g * y0^2. When entire chain leaves edge, hanging mass is lambda*L with center of mass at -L/2, so U_f = -0.5 * lambda * g * L^2. Kinetic energy of entire chain: K_f = 0.5 * (lambda * L) * v^2. By conservation of energy: 0.5 * lambda * L * v^2 = 0.5 * lambda * g * (L^2 - y0^2) => L * v^2 = g * (L^2 - y0^2) => v = sqrt(g * (L - y0^2 / L)). Matches option a.
